break_glass.notes: A CLI flag alone is never sufficient authorization. Break-glass must be a named approval artifact under artifacts/break-glass/ with actor, reason, expiration, and scope.

protected_clients.notes: Never mutate, hydrate, deploy, migrate, or include in fleet/canary without a named break-glass approval artifact (actor, reason, expiration, scope). Do not invent a client_id UUID. A null client_id is an additional protection condition, not an error that permits mutation. Registering a UUID later does not authorize mutation.
